dateline: Busan, South Korea — BTS THE CITY ARIRANG Busan opens June 5 with drone light show over Gwangan Bridge and ARMY MADANG fan plaza at The Bay 101; 'Hooligan' official performance video released on Bangtan TV as FESTA Day 5; FESTA Family Photo (June 4) — first full seven-member shot since military service completion; anniversary concerts at Busan Asiad Main Stadium June 12–13: 7 days away
heroHeadline: Day 4,740: 'BTS THE CITY ARIRANG Busan' Opens; 'Hooligan' Performance Video Released; 13th Anniversary 7 Days Away
heroSubtitle: June 5, 2026 is Day 4,740 since BTS's June 13, 2013 debut and Day 5 of BTS FESTA 2026. 'BTS THE CITY ARIRANG Busan' officially opens today across multiple Busan locations (running through June 21), transforming BTS's hometown — birthplace of Jimin and Jungkook — into a citywide fan festival ahead of the June 12–13 Busan Asiad Main Stadium anniversary concerts. Highlights include a drone light show over Gwangan Bridge, an ARIRANG exhibition and merchandise space at Shinsegae Centum City, a light mapping show at Busan Cinema Center, and an ARMY MADANG fan community plaza at The Bay 101. Busan's government has designated June 5–13 as 'BTS WEEK,' with purple lighting across major landmarks and BTS-branded public transport. Simultaneously, Big Hit Music released the official performance video for 'Hooligan' — the ARIRANG World Tour's opening track — on Bangtan TV YouTube as FESTA 2026 Day 5 content, giving global ARMY their first high-resolution documentation of the tour's iconic stage opener. On June 4 (FESTA Day 4), BTS released the traditional FESTA Family Photo — their first full seven-member anniversary photoshoot since completing military service, trending globally across X and Instagram. The June 13 debut anniversary is now 7 days away; the Busan Asiad Main Stadium shows (June 12–13) will be live-streamed globally via Trafalgar Releasing cinema viewing.
